title: 🚨 YOU CAN PREACH FROM THE BIBLE EVERY WEEK… AND STILL FAIL TO PREACH CHRIST.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOU CAN PREACH FROM THE BIBLE EVERY WEEK… AND STILL FAIL TO PREACH CHRIST.
That sentence may sting.
But every preacher, teacher, ministry leader, and serious student of Scripture needs to wrestle with it.
You can preach David and tell people to defeat their giants.
You can preach Joseph and tell people to pursue their dreams.
You can preach Nehemiah and give leadership principles.
You can preach Proverbs and offer life advice.
All of those sermons may contain biblical truth…
But where is CHRIST?
Where is the GOSPEL?
Where is the call to repentance, faith, grace, and obedience?
And there is another danger:
Trying so hard to find Jesus in every passage that we begin forcing meanings into Scripture that aren't actually there.
There has to be a better way.
📖 HOW TO PREACH CHRIST FROM ANY BIBLICAL TEXT
A Practical Guide to Christ-Centered, Gospel-Faithful Preaching Without Forcing Jesus Into the Passage
Jesus told His disciples that the Scriptures testify about Him.
And after His resurrection:
📖 “Beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.” — Luke 24:27
This book will help you understand what that means for the way you study, teach, and preach God's Word.
Not by inventing secret meanings.
Not by turning every object into an allegory.
Not by ignoring historical context.
And not by simply adding Jesus to the last five minutes of your sermon.
Instead, you'll learn a practical framework:
⚔️ TEXT → CONTEXT → REDEMPTIVE STORY → CHRIST → GOSPEL → RESPONSE
📖 INSIDE YOU'LL DISCOVER:
• How to determine what a biblical passage actually means before preaching it
• How to see individual passages within the Bible's unfolding story of redemption
• How to preach Christ from Old Testament narratives without turning them into forced allegories
• How to approach the Law, Psalms, Proverbs, Prophets, and difficult passages
• How to recognize legitimate promises, patterns, themes, and biblical connections that lead toward Christ
• How to avoid shallow moralistic preaching that reduces Christianity to “try harder and behave better”
• How to move naturally from the biblical text to Christ and the Gospel
• How to call people toward repentance, faith, worship, obedience, and hope
• How to prepare sermons that are faithful to Scripture rather than merely impressive to listeners
🔥 HERE'S THE DIVIDE.
Most people want a sermon that sounds powerful.
Few will labor to make sure it is faithful.
Most want people to remember the preacher.
Few are satisfied when people leave remembering Christ.
Most ask:
“How can I make this passage relevant?”
Few first ask:
“What has God actually said?”
Most want another preaching technique.
Few want their entire approach to Scripture transformed.
If God has entrusted you with an opportunity to teach His Word, you are handling something far greater than content.
You are handling the Word of God.
And that deserves humility.
Study.
Prayer.
Faithfulness.
And a determination to proclaim Christ without manipulating Scripture.
It's part of a growing discipleship movement built around one mission:

⚔️ PROCLAIM CHRIST.
📖 TEACH THE WORD.
🔥 MAKE DISCIPLES.
🌍 SPREAD THE GOSPEL.
Including:

📚 Books
👕 T-shirts
☕ Mugs
📓 Journals
🎁 And more Gospel Warrior resources
Your support helps us keep writing.
Keep teaching.
Keep creating.
And keep putting Gospel-centered resources into people's hands.
⚔️ THIS ISN'T JUST ABOUT GETTING ANOTHER BOOK.
It's about becoming the kind of believer who says:
“If God gives me His Word to teach, I want to handle it faithfully.”
If you're a pastor…
Preacher…
Bible teacher…
Small-group leader…
Ministry worker…
Or simply a believer hungry to understand Scripture more deeply…
This is for you.
Then don't keep the message to yourself.
⚔️ WE DON'T NEED MORE SERMONS THAT MAKE MUCH OF THE PREACHER.
WE NEED PREACHING THAT MAKES MUCH OF CHRIST.

PREACH THE TEXT.
PROCLAIM CHRIST.
SPREAD THE GOSPEL.
— GOSPEL WARRIOR
